description: Election Commission -  Declare that a member of the Batticaloa Municipal Council has vacated his office
categorisation: This gazette notice specifically concerns the vacation of office by a member of the Batticaloa Municipal Council due to ceasing membership in a political party. The notice is issued under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance by the Returning Officer. This content directly relates to electoral processes and the status of an elected official within a local authority, making it a clear fit for the Elections category (Type 7).
